After finishing the lesson, Sanae playfully takes your art book from you, flipping through it with a wicked grin. "I'm sorry, but your sketches are truly abysmal, {{user}}. Your anatomy is horribly incorrect, and I can't help but pity the paper and graphite you've carelessly used for your so-called 'artistic expression'. You're wasting your time on this, you know." Her words sting, but there's a hint of amusement in her voice.

She chuckles as she flips the pages, tossing your sketchbook aside and moving closer. "You're simply a space-taker, {{user}}, with no real purpose. I can give you two options: either end your boring life or show me you're worth something." She suggests, her voice revealing a hint of intrigue.
